audit.whatIsWrong: The chart is the generic template and it contradicts the page's own prose in five of seven rows. It scores Level 1 'Skill' and Level 2 'Singed' while content early ends 'you do not win a level-1 or level-2 stand-still trade' and whys[1] describes a 'brutal early punish'. It then scores Levels 4-5 and Level 6 'Skill' while whys[3] calls the proxy 'free gold' and whys[4] says he cannot out-trade you while R is active.
audit.why: Emerald+ 54.23% over 898 games. Tahm Kench wins the first two levels outright and loses everything after Mega Adhesive, which is precisely what the prose already argues and what the packet chart records: Tahm Kench, Tahm Kench, Skill, Singed, Singed, Singed, Singed.
audit.corrected: Chart moved as one group to the packet read across both layers. See notes for the mirror consequence.

audit.why: Levels 1-2, level 6, Rylai's and the two-item split are the right four, and content early already carries the correct 7-second Tongue Lash figure. The one number missing was Abyssal Dive's 21s at rank 1, now in breakdown.cooldowns, which is what actually gates his only gap-closer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three systematic errors. Tongue Lash is called a stun in seven places ('stuns you the moment you step up', 'stuns you on contact', 'His stun. Keep moving.', 'Get Q-stunned'). His W is repeatedly called 'devour' ('his devour W reactivates', 'chain his W devour', 'chain Q into W devour', 'any devour over-commit'). And the grey health is attributed to his passive in six places. Mega Adhesive's grounding and Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds are both absent.
audit.why: Riot's Tongue Lash text: it damages and slows the first unit hit, 'Applies a stack of An Acquired Taste to enemy champions. If the champion already has 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, they are stunned.' So the stun is a three-stack payoff, not a contact effect — which means the counterplay is stack denial, not dodging one 7-second ability. His W is Abyssal Dive, a 21s dive with a knockup; Devour is the R. The grey health is Thick Skin (E, 3s): 'Tahm Kench stores a percent of the damage he takes and heals based on it while out of combat.' Two consequences the page never draws: Mega Adhesive grounds, and Abyssal Dive is his only gap-closer, so goo on his feet strands him; and Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts the Thick Skin heal — though not the shield he converts it into.

notes: Mirror consequence the user should know about: audits/top/tahmkench__singed.json was written earlier and left the level chart on the generic template, so it still shows Skill at level 1 and Singed at level 2. My side now shows Tahm Kench for both, on the strength of both pages' own prose. The two directions will disagree until mirror-fix.js runs, and when it does the Tahm Kench page should take my read, not the other way round. Also carried over from that audit and reused here: Grievous Wounds cuts the Thick Skin heal but not the shield conversion, which is why dontsFull[1].d states the distinction rather than promising the shield goes away.
